Name: (FS) RoseDryad's Fairy Wings And Accessories
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
Adds fairy wings, plant hats, witch hats, and flower crowns using Fashion Sense.

[b]Wings:[/b]
[list]
[*]Small Fairy Wings (colorable)
[*]Medium Fairy Wings (colorable)
[*]Large Fairy Wings (colorable)
[*]Dragonfly (colorable) [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Leaf (colorable) [b]NEW[/b]
[/list]
[b]Hats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Pink Flower Petal Hat
[*]Purple Flower Petal Hat
[*]Red Flower Petal Hat
[*]Pink Floral Witch Hat
[*]Mushroom Witch Hat
[*]Plain Witch Hat (colorable) [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Red Mushroom Hat [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Sprout Hat (colorable) [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Sunflower Hat [b]NEW[/b]
[/list]
[b]Flower Crowns:[/b]
[list]
[*]Purple Rose Crown
[*]Red Rose Crown
[*]Pastel Rainbow Flower Crown [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Rainbow Flower Crown [b]NEW[/b]
[/list]
More accessories plus clothes coming soon!

You'll need to buy the Hand Mirror Tool from Pierre's.
Left-click to open the menu and select the accessories you want by using the arrows.
